text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sight of Aston Machan
sprinting across Nakayama Racecourse was breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She kicks up dirt with all her might, spinning again and again,
her speed picking up with every blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The entire grandstand held their breath watching her. And then, from out of nowhere, a voice could be heard.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Aston Machan is amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan: Mission accomplished!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on! Chan-chan's still
in the Classic class, isn't she...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And you ran a race like that after all that!?
Th-That's incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Chan-chan!
Thank you for such an incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous applause and earth-shaking cheers.
She gazed out at the stands, looking completely overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I did it. I really did it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A deep, deep mark.
You've left one right on me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her, I couldn't help but recall
all those days that seemed so effortless on the surface,
yet were filled with desperate effort.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
You were watching—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, tears?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A surge of burning emotion welled up inside.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Today, I was able to leave
an impression on so many people's hearts.
Chan-Me thinks so too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That made you so happy
you couldn't help but cry, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is it, perhaps...
because this is a matter of great importance to Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I see. ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan looked into the air, seemingly bewildered.
She appeared to be searching for words.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan's dream is
to become an Ultra Super Mascot."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan will do her best for that.
It's only natural,
because it's about Mar-chan, after all."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer-san is the lens that will capture
and spread lots and lots of Machan for that dream.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This lens is very devoted to its job.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought that was all there was to it.
However, that was—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan then looked toward me.
My face reflected in her round, wide eyes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: No. That is not the case, is it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Now I'm even more confused.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The more I think back on it,
the less I understand you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Even though it isn't work, aren't you doing far, far too much for Chan-san?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't you treating Mar-chan's major crisis
a little too much like your own?"
choice_data_list: I thought that was only natural, though...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
That means, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san is like that moment when
Machan drew the best picture of her life.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Does it mean standing by my side as a given,
and sharing in Chan-chan's joy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether she noticed my bewilderment or not,
she continued talking.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: If Chan lost, you were just as sad, and if Chan set a record, you were just as happy—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Beside me, they felt the exact same way—dazzled by the view of the stands, deeply touched by the roaring cheers.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Is that... is that really what it means?
choice_data_list: I think that's what it means.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
......
That's strange.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...It feels... It almost feels
like we're drifting down the river together.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Something like that, something like that... It's just ridiculous for that to happen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because... the boat holds only one. One must drift down alone,
endure the rushing rapids, and journey out into the open sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Steering is already difficult as it is.
There's a high chance we could get separated along the way."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: “Even so, I believe I'll keep going down this river with Machan. That's what I believe.”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To believe in someone as naturally as breathing...
Is that what it means?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If you are asking whether I intend to remain
by her side and continue supporting her from now on—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her round eyes blinked rapidly. They wandered in the air as if searching for an answer, and after a brief pause—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Always by her side, continuing to capture Chan-chan...
...Is that so. I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, you're a strange person.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What a strange person you are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, looking somewhat relieved,
she gave a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, as long as you are here,
Mar-chan will not disappear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Aston Machan never said
another word about it after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She didn't clearly explain what she meant by "weird" either, but――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That subtle air she carried—as if in a rush
to live her life—felt like it had softened
just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home that day, Aston Machan
gave me a certain gift.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"This is the Mar-chan Doll Prototype No. 3.0.
Since Mar-chan hadn't given it to you yet.
Please make do with this for now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Chan-doll handed to me
was heavier than expected.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Once the official URA version is ready,
I'll hand it to you again, Trainer.
You'll be the very first to get it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Giving this to you first
isn't just because you're my Trainer,
you know."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Because you are you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Machan has realized.
That you continue to hold onto it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That is the safest and most secure way.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, perfectly safe and sound.
No doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As usual, there are still many things
where her intentions aren't quite clear, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this means she has acknowledged me as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold the gifted Chan-me doll
tightly in both hands once more.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, and that reminds me.
About the next race..."
choice_data_list: Is there one you want to run in?
Is there one you'd like to enter?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It would be rather boorish of me to even ask.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the grand Senior-class sprint stage,
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I can perform well there, I'm sure...
I'll be able to give you the real deal.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The next race was the 'Takamatsunomiya Kinen'.
Once again, spring was coming.
